issues.problem: subject values 将棋 (shogi) and 生け花 (flower arranging) are well above the pack's lv 4 band.
issues.action: Replaced with 日本語 (Japanese) and 絵 (painting).

issues.problem: Cause values 大きな音 and 大きな地震 make で (cause) as natural as に (音で驚いた, 地震で驚いた), so the focus blank had a second correct answer that was not listed.
issues.action: Replaced with 見事な演奏 (the brilliant performance) and 意外な答え (the unexpected answer), which naturally take に only.

issues.problem: Frame '<target>への<thing>を送りました' also allows plain に (先生に手紙を送りました) with the same English, so the blank had two correct answers. Several things (メール, 返事, メッセージ) could not be reused in a physical frame.
issues.action: Rewrote the frame as '<target>への<thing>{は/が}<place>にあります' ('The letter to my teacher is in the drawer'), where only への can link the two nouns. New thing and place variables (6 each, physical objects; English carries to/for), and the target 'a friend' changed to 'my friend'. 252 combinations.

issues.problem: No problems found: に alternative listed, distractors wrong in every combination, English correct.
